rule: Flip passes to true only after verifying with evidence (output or screenshot), hands only, no controller. Evidence goes in progress.md. Owner A+B means both halves need evidence: A = recognition/audio, B = visual. Task ids refer to .coord/tasks/biyon-N.md (list in stemlight/docs/TASKS.md).

features.description: Pipeline renders the Beethoven 5th mvt 1 excerpt (Mutopia #941) into 8 mono group stems (opus) with notes.json, beats.json, envelopes.json, manifest.json
features.how_to_test: validate.py: every group has a stem; per-stem note total matches the source excerpt; stems equal length within 1 ms; listen-through in a DAW (tasks 5-7, 21)

features.description: Dvorak 9 mvt 4 (~2:30, Mutopia #1793, CC BY-SA 3.0) and our own Trepak arrangement both render through the pipeline
features.how_to_test: validate.py passes for both; Tue 10 18:00 listening gate by sir and banit; authorship and licences in ASSETS.md (tasks 18-21). If the Trepak fails the gate, F02 covers Dvorak only

features.description: All stems play in sync from one context start time
features.how_to_test: After 3 min play and 10 seeks, measured stem offsets stay within 5 ms (task 8)

features.description: Fist on the summoned creature silences it while held and its notes freeze to glass; opening restores it
features.how_to_test: Scripted IWER hand via DevHandPose: 20 fist/open cycles, 20 correct results, gain verified (A, task 12); screenshots of held state (B, task 41)

features.description: Double pinch solos an instrument; repeat clears solo
features.how_to_test: Scripted IWER: 20 double pinches set and clear solo; 20 with an injected tracking gap give 0 solos (task 13)

features.description: Fist, pinch and double pinch never trigger each other
features.how_to_test: 20 scripted of each gesture near and far from targets; zero cross-triggers (task 14)

features.description: A 0.3 s tracking gap does not cancel or flip an action; a longer gap releases quietly
features.how_to_test: xr_set_connected false for 0.3 s mid-gesture: state holds; 0.5 s: quiet release, no action fired (tasks 10, 14)

features.description: Two-hand stretch changes a stem's 3-band EQ audibly; the creature reshapes if EQ shape-morph ships
features.how_to_test: Scripted stretch; filter gains logged within +-12 dB; reset 10/10 (A, task 15); before/after screenshots (B, task 43)

features.description: Score ribbon: pinch the playhead to pause, drag to scrub, release to resume
features.how_to_test: Scripted IWER pinch and drag; transport time follows hand within 50 ms; audio and notes resume in sync (A, task 16; B, task 45)

features.description: Trim: two-hand pinch on a lane cuts that region (beat-snapped); pulling the region away undoes it
features.how_to_test: 20 scripted trims: region silent on playback; region drawn hollow; 10 undos (A, task 23; B, task 46)

features.description: Pads: strikes record, snap to the beat grid and loop over the cut region
features.how_to_test: Scripted strikes off-grid by up to 60 ms land on grid; loop repeats in time for 3 cycles (A, tasks 24-25; B, task 47)

features.description: Harp: 8 strings tuned to the piece's scale, recorded and looped
features.how_to_test: Scripted plucks; every note in key; loop plays back (A, task 26; B, task 48)

features.description: Keyboard (cut line): one key-locked octave of 8 big keys, recorded and looped
features.how_to_test: Scripted presses; notes recorded and looped (A, task 27; B, task 49)

features.description: Notes: every glyph is a real note; glyph matches length, height = pitch, size = loudness, swell on beat; position is a pure function of transport time
features.how_to_test: Compare 20 random visible glyphs against notes.json; pause freezes and seek rewinds notes; screenshot (tasks 34, 37, 38)

features.description: User's own notes fly out of their hands in warm amber into the ghost outlines
features.how_to_test: Scripted pad strikes; screenshot shows amber glyphs leaving the hand (task 47)

features.description: Creatures pulse from envelopes; muted creatures dim; solo dims the others
features.how_to_test: Screenshots at loud and quiet passages, while muted and while soloed (tasks 40, 41)

features.description: Nebula sky, ocean depth and plankton within the draw-call budget
features.how_to_test: Sky, ocean and plankton together 3 draw calls or fewer; under 100 total logged in IWER at the heaviest moment (tasks 44, 31)

features.description: Landing page: one large Enter, pitch line, no account, hand-tracking hint
features.how_to_test: Enter by pinch in IWER from a fresh browser state (task 35)

features.description: First pinch unlocks audio and the first payoff lands within 15 s; a tester who does nothing gets a nudge
features.how_to_test: Timed fresh run in IWER; 10 s idle triggers the nudge (task 55)

features.description: Tutorial teaches summon, silence, return, lock, solo, ribbon, EQ, cut and pads with ghost hands and under 15 words
features.how_to_test: Complete in IWER by copying ghost hands; word count logged (task 56)

features.description: All shipped pieces (2 or 3) play in order, then free play unlocks with the end card
features.how_to_test: Full timed run in IWER, no errors in console (task 57)

features.description: Mix and recorded parts are saved on the device and restored
features.how_to_test: Change mix, record a part, reload: both restored. Clear storage: clean start, no error (task 28)

features.description: Clean pause and resume without repeating the tutorial; returning users see their saved state
features.how_to_test: Visibility change and session end in IWER; state and audio restored; reload skips tutorial (A, task 29; B, task 58)

features.description: Every hand action has a spatial sound
features.how_to_test: Checklist of actions vs sounds; every sound file in ASSETS.md (tasks 52, 53)

features.description: Credits list every score, sample library, font and impulse response with licence, including the CC BY-SA attribution for Dvorak
features.how_to_test: Compare against ASSETS.md, no missing rows (task 53)

features.description: Performance budget: under 100 draw calls, under 150k triangles, at most 1,500 live notes, fps counter behind a dev flag
features.how_to_test: Logged in IWER at the heaviest moment. Real-device fps only if a headset is found; otherwise stated as unverified (tasks 30, 31)

features.description: Essential UI and interactions inside about 70x66 degrees, seated within 2 ft
features.how_to_test: Screenshots with FoV mask from a seated pose (task 63)

features.description: Judge link opens on a fresh browser, build pinned, no deploy after the pin
features.how_to_test: Fresh profile run on the release candidate (tasks 33, 69)

features.description: A first-time tester completes the tutorial uncoached (emulator, or headset if found)
features.how_to_test: Stopwatch notes, no help given; tester can say why they would return (task 66)

features.description: Glowing hands: glow brightens near targets, pulses on the beat, fades when tracking is weak
features.how_to_test: IWER screenshots near and far from a target and on a beat; draw calls rise by 5 or fewer; live notes still capped at 1,500 (task 50)

features.description: Colour-blind palette toggle; instrument families distinguishable by shape alone
features.how_to_test: Screenshot in both palettes plus a greyscale capture; every family is identifiable in greyscale (task 51)

features.description: Look to summon: head direction within 12 degrees for 0.5 s glides that creature to the reach spot
features.how_to_test: Scripted head yaw to each of 9 creatures: 20/20 correct gaze:summon (A, task 11); glide screenshots (B, task 41)

features.description: Fist held 1.5 s locks the silence; a fist on a locked creature returns it
features.how_to_test: 20 scripted lock cycles stay silent after opening (A, task 12); lock ring screenshots (B, task 41)

features.description: Count-in: one bar of ticks and a filling ring before the cut region
features.how_to_test: 4 countin events per bar logged (A, task 25); ring screenshot (B, task 47)

features.description: Guide track: the original part plays at -18 dB under the user's first loop only
features.how_to_test: Gain logged at -18 dB on loop 1 and silent on loop 2 (task 25)

features.description: Ghost notes: a cut region shows its original notes as hollow outlines
features.how_to_test: Scripted cut: outlines match exactly that region's notes from notes.json (task 46)

features.description: Thaw on return: glass cracks and shatters into sparkles, notes resume
features.how_to_test: Screenshots at 0, 200 and 600 ms after open (task 42)

features.description: DevHandPose dev harness lets scripted IWER tests make a fist and partial curls; absent from the production build
features.how_to_test: ecs_set_component DevHandPose fist then get_hand_state shows curl >= 0.75; grep of dist/ finds no DevHandPose (task 4)

features.description: Decoded stem memory logged per piece; previous piece's buffers released on change
features.how_to_test: Decoded MB logged for each piece; heap drops after a switch in Chrome; stated as unverified on Quest (task 17)

features.description: Quiet reset: pinch and hold the shell for 2 s resets this piece's mix only
features.how_to_test: 10 scripted resets clear the current piece only (A, task 29); ring fills (B, task 58)
